 By Staff Report | Hartford Courant Staff PUBLISHED: October 24, 2026 at 5:30 AM EDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready... A Connecticut tax preparer is facing federal charges for allegedly preparing numerous false income tax returns.
 A grand jury in New Haven returned an indictment on Oct. 7 charging 43-year-old Yuridia Trujillo with 19 counts of aiding and assisting in the preparation and presentation of a false income tax return, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Connecticut . The offense carries a maximum term of three years in prison on each count.
 Court records show that Trujillo operated as a tax return preparer under the business name Yuri’s LLC.
 The investigation, conducted by the Internal Revenue Service, Criminal Investigation Division, determined that, for the 2017 through 2024 tax years, Trujillo prepared at least 4,335 tax returns for clients.
 According to the indictment, investigators discovered that Trujillo allegedly made “materially false entries, including false deductions for Individual Retirement Account contributions and child and dependent care expenses; fabricated businesses and business deductions; fictitious losses for the buying and selling of stocks and cryptocurrency that clients never owned; and fabricated rental properties that would report little to no rental income, but significant deductible rental expenses.”
 The indictment also alleged that, in addition to preparing and filing Forms 1040 for her clients, Trujillo was also allegedly filing Forms 8888, entitled “Allocation of Refund,” which allows taxpayers to have a portion of their direct deposit tax refund deposited into up to three bank accounts. “Trujillo filed false Forms 8888 in connection with client tax returns that included the bank account and routing numbers of her own bank account and the bank account of an associate, thereby diverting a portion of client refunds to herself,” the indictment alleged.
 Trujillo was arrested on Oct. 9 and is currently released on a $50,000 bond pending trial.
